1: # ADR 0003: PostgreSQL Append-Only Audit Trigger, Soft-Deletable IAM Lifecycle, and ArchUnit Bounded-Context Isolation
2: 
3: - **Date:** 2026-10-29
4: - **Status:** Proposed
5: 
6: <!-- An Accepted ADR stays. A later decision writes the next file and sets this line to "Superseded by ADR <NN>". Do not edit Decision or Alternatives after Accepted. -->
7: - **Deciders:** mdurana
8: 
9: ## Context
10: 
11: Story `P1-B` (`p1-b-iam-and-audit-persistence`) delivers the physical Flyway persistence schema (`V2__iam_and_audit_schema.sql`), JPA entity/repository layers, and ArchUnit bounded-context isolation rules for the `iam` (`com.example.app.iam`) and `audit` (`com.example.app.audit`) contexts inside `app/backend/`. Governing requirements from `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p1-b-iam-and-audit-persistence.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, and `ADR 0001` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0001-modular-monolith-architecture.md`) establish three non-trivial persistence and boundary constraints:
12: 
13: 1. **Tamper-Evident 13-Month Audit Trail (`AC-3`, `AC-5`, BSP Circular 982 / 1019, VAPT F10):**
14:    - `audit_log_entries` must capture all security and domain events (`occurred_at`, `workspace_email`, `actor_user_id`, `effective_view_as_role`, `event_type`, `action_name`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `outcome`, `correlation_id`, `search_query_text`, `mutation_payload_json`, `client_ip`) and remain queryable online for at least 13 months within the `p95 <= 600 ms` SLO (`docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md`).
15:    - Any attempt to modify (`UPDATE`) or remove (`DELETE`) an existing `audit_log_entries` row—whether through a bug in a repository method, a compromised service query, or direct SQL execution using the application's database credentials—must be deterministically refused at the database level with an exception containing `"audit_log_entries is append-only"`.
16: 2. **Soft-Deletable IAM Role/Permission Lifecycle & Referential Integrity (`AC-1`, `AC-2`, `AC-6`):**
17:    - Roles (`roles`) and permissions (`permissions`) are referenced by `role_permissions` and `user_role_assignments` (which also tracks `assigned_by_user_id`, `source_ticket_id`, `expires_at`, and `revoked_at`) and by `sod_conflict_rules` (`primary_role_id`, `conflicting_role_id`).
18:    - When an administrator deletes a role or permission (`DELETE /api/v1/iam/roles/{id}`, `DELETE /api/v1/iam/permissions/{id}`) and later revives it (`POST /api/v1/iam/roles/{id}/revive`, `POST /api/v1/iam/permissions/{id}/revive`), historical foreign-key references in `user_role_assignments` and `role_permissions` must never break or cascade-delete, optimistic concurrency (`roles.version`) must prevent lost updates, and unique business keys (`roles.role_code`, `permissions.permission_code`) must remain enforced.
19: 3. **Compile-Time / Test-Time Modular Monolith Isolation (`AC-7`, `ADR 0001`):**
20:    - All five bounded contexts (`com.example.app.iam`, `com.example.app.configuration`, `com.example.app.execution`, `com.example.app.governance`, `com.example.app.audit`) share a single JVM (`app/backend/`) and a single PostgreSQL 15 database (`portal_db`). Without automated boundary enforcement in `LayerRulesTest`, a developer could import another bounded context's `..repository..`, `..entity..`, or `..domain..` classes directly, bypassing cross-context service/port contracts.

80: - **Interactive IAM & Notification Reads/Mutations**: Indexed foreign keys on `notification_events(recipient_user_id, is_read, created_at)` and `user_role_assignments(user_id, is_active)` support `p95 <= 400 ms` reads and `p95 <= 800 ms` mutations (`docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md`).
81: - **Data Durability & Retention (Tier 1 RPO/RTO)**: `RPO <= 5 minutes`, `RTO <= 30 minutes`, 13-month online retention in PostgreSQL 15 with zero modification or deletion of `audit_log_entries` rows (`docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md`).
82: - **Observability**: Structured audit persistence requires non-null `correlation_id`, `occurred_at`, `workspace_email`, `event_type`, `action_name`, `resource_type`, and `outcome` on every `audit_log_entries` row (`security-baseline.mdc` §3, §12).
83: - **Stack & Async/Cache Justification (`project-delivery-core.mdc`)**: Java 21 / Spring Boot 4.1.1 modular monolith (`app/backend/`) with PostgreSQL 15 and Flyway (`migration-safety` expand-and-contract discipline). No new broker or cache infrastructure is introduced in this story; `notification_events` persists delivery state (`email_delivery_status`, `email_retry_count`) in PostgreSQL for bounded async SMTP retry in `P2`.
84: 
85: ## Security-review triggers
86: 
87: - `RBAC` — Physical persistence schema for `users`, `roles`, `permissions`, `role_permissions`, `user_role_assignments` (including `expires_at` and `revoked_at`), and `sod_conflict_rules` (`primary_role_id`, `conflicting_role_id`, `conflict_type`, `action_scope`, `enforce_in_non_prod`), plus append-only security audit persistence in `audit_log_entries` enforced by a PostgreSQL `BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE` trigger (`security-baseline.mdc` §2, §11, §12; VAPT F10).
88: - **Sensitive actions (for Design step-up / dual-control evaluation)**: IAM role and permission mutations, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflict rule definitions, user role assignment grants/revocations, and tamper-evident persistence of security audit events (`audit_log_entries`).
89: 
90: ## Regulations
91: 
92: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Financial Audit Controls)**: Enforces Segregation of Duties (SoD) rule persistence (`sod_conflict_rules`), soft-deletable role/permission lifecycle preserving historical foreign keys (`roles`, `permissions`, `user_role_assignments`), and a 13-month online append-only audit trail (`audit_log_entries`) protected against database-level `UPDATE` or `DELETE` tampering.
93: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Governs persistence of corporate workspace identity attributes (`workspace_email`, `display_name`, `department`, `client_ip`) in `users`, `audit_log_entries`, and `notification_events` with strict bounded-context encapsulation and referential integrity.
94: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §2, §3, §12 & VAPT F10)**: Mandates immutable security event logging (`correlation_id`, `workspace_email`, `effective_view_as_role`, `outcome`, `mutation_payload_json`), role/permission persistence supporting fail-closed RBAC evaluation, and ArchUnit module boundary enforcement.
